<a id="charset_source"></a>
### [`charset_source`](../../../../src/data/charset_source.asm#L6) `$3000-$30FF`

*data*

Source of the multicolour character set. $4288 copies all 256 chars ($3000-$37ff) to the charset at $2000-$27ff at game start.

### [`dot_chars_source`](../../../../src/data/charset_source.asm#L123) `$3380`

*data*

### [`masked_chars_source`](../../../../src/data/charset_source.asm#L139) `$33E0-$33FF`

### [`dither_chars_source`](../../../../src/data/charset_source.asm#L147) `$3408-$34BF`

*data*

Chars $81-$98, four groups of 6 chars. $704c copies each group to $2408 and dithers it with random bits when flag $4003+X is not 0.

<a id="dither_chars_last"></a>
### [`dither_chars_last`](../../../../src/data/charset_source.asm#L172) `$34C0-$34FF`

*data*

Char $98, then chars $99-$9e are zero. $4e24 (not executed) sets sprite pointer $d3, which shows $34c0-$34ff as sprite 7.
